projects.title: Command
bullets: Built a Go command-line tool refined over many small iterations, adding tests as edge cases surfaced during everyday use.
Kept the tool's behavior backward compatible across dozens of small releases by relying on its test suite before each change.

projects.title: Termin All Or Nothing
bullets: Built a VS Code extension in TypeScript, writing a test suite around its editor integration using a custom test stubber.
Debugged inconsistent extension behavior across editor versions, learning to isolate environment differences before touching application logic.

projects.title: Euler Challenge
bullets: Solved a long series of computational problems in Go and Python, generating charts and PDFs to visualize each solution.

leadership.title: Peer Tutor
bullets: Volunteered to debug classmates' projects across unfamiliar languages and frameworks, often starting with only a vague description of the bug.
Found that asking for a minimal reproduction case before diving in saved far more time than guessing at the cause.
